name: Hanazono no Musume
source:
Main character breaks up with his girlfriend and goes to the sea thinking about suicide. He calms down a little and turns back when his leg slips dragging him  in the den below the cliff.
He wakes up in a Western-style mansion inhabited by three young women and one housekeeper. He has to stay there till he recovers. What secret is hidden inside the building?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角與女友分手後，想到海邊自殺。他稍微冷靜下來正準備返回，卻腳下一滑，墜入懸崖下的洞穴。醒來時，他身處一座西式宅邸，住著三名年輕女性與一名管家。他必須留在那裡養傷。這棟建築藏著什麼秘密？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
